execution: Only the shared successor C275 environment; no production or second application environment.

browser.open: open({actor,am,agentId?}) => {page,origin,switchAM(nextAm),close()}; real compiled Playwright page with isolated cookies; named roles must not fall back to admin.
browser.evidence: evidence(page) => {requests:[{method,path,status,request_id,am}], artifacts?:[{sha256}]}; include actual public requests, no credential values.

admin-fixtures.take: take(name,ctx) returns an owned setup with scope=LOCAL_DISPOSABLE_TWO_AM, cleanup() and the data/methods listed below. Register cleanup immediately. Missing setup must throw Blocked, never return a pass oracle.

methods.revoke: revoke(actor,capability) => restoration callback; change actual local auth provider authorization, no fabricated HTTP response

requirements: Known allocation history across at least two owners and runtime images
At least 51 choices/rows for actual UI cursor traversal where requested
Duplicate owner names with separately authorized directory context
Unavailable measured points and nonzero infrastructure-only quantities
Fresh exact expected totals for each requested time window; truth derives from fixture seed, not report responses

methods.arm: arm({kind,method,path,am?}) => {release(),close(),observations()}; local forwarding proxy or real configuration fault only; kinds include hold_response, drop_accepted_response, disabled_view, busy, unavailable, expire_report. Preserve the real upstream result and source/request identity.

requirements: Observe upstream acceptance before dropping a mutation response
Restore every injected fault on failure

methods.observeProvider: Read-only actual native resource/home identity and finality
methods.workWitness: Read actual already-running work state; no new side effects
methods.replayAdmission: Replay the retained original public admission using its same immutable key/body and return the HTTP receipt

requirements: Public-created disposable cross-owner Sandbox and all profile kinds
Older immutable runtime with real upgrade available and active work
Known sandbox event history spans more than 50 events
Parent owns cleanup custody immediately after resource creation

methods.observeProvider: Actual spare and claimed runtime identities/counts; distinguish desired, pending and Ready
methods.claimedAgentWitness: Read existing Agent state/reply continuity through public APIs

requirements: Unique capacity tuple, at most one spare
Cleanup sets only owned pool targets to zero with fresh CAS and verifies provider finality

limits: Fixture definitions are requirements, not runtime bindings or PASS claims
All API calls and cleanup retain original uncertainty; never silently retry with a new key
At least two seconds between explicit report/lifecycle polls
